(present-day [[Bangladesh]]) | nationality = Bangladeshi | known_for = | occupation = Politician | profession = Judge | party = [[Bangladesh Awami League]]{{cite web | url=https://www.wionews.com/south-asia/mohammad-shahabuddin-chuppu-poised-to-become-the-next-president-of-bangladesh-561180 | title=Mohammad Shahabuddin Chuppu poised to become the next president of Bangladesh }} | spouse = [[Rebecca Sultana]] | children = 1 | education = [[Govt. Edward College, Pabna]] | alma_mater = [[University of Rajshahi]]
([[Master of Science|MSc]], [[Bachelor of Laws|LLB]]) | father = Sharfuddin Ansari | mother = Khairunnesa }} '''Muhammad Shahabuddin Chuppu''' ({{lang-bn|মোহাম্মদ সাহাবুদ্দিন চুপ্পু}}, born 10 December 1949) is a Bangladeshi jurist, politician and [[Mukti Bahini|freedom fighter]] who is the [[President of Bangladesh|President-elect of Bangladesh]]. He was nominated by the ruling [[Bangladesh Awami League]] as their candidate for the [[2023 Bangladeshi presidential election|2023 presidential election]]. He has served in numerous capacities, including as a district and sessions judge and a commissioner of the [[Anti-Corruption Commission (Bangladesh)|Anti-Corruption Commission]] from 2011 to 2016.{{Cite web |date=12 February 2023 |title=AL nominates Shahabuddin Chuppu for country's next President |url=https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/politics/al-nominates-shahabuddin-chuppu-next-president-583850 |access-date=2023-02-12 |website=The Business Standard |language=en}} == Early life and education == Chuppu was born on 10 December 1949 in the Jubilee Tank area in Shivrampur of [[Pabna Sadar Upazila|Sadar Upazila]] of [[Pabna District]] in erstwhile [[East Bengal]], [[Dominion of Pakistan]] (present-day [[Bangladesh]]).{{Cite web |last=Arafat |first=Aditya |date=13 March 2016 |title=অবসরে থাকছেন বদিউজ্জামান, সুপ্রিম কোর্টে ফিরছেন চুপ্পু |trans-title=Badiuzzaman to go in retirement, Chuppu to return in Supreme Court |url=https://www.banglanews24.com/cat/news/bd/473284.details |access-date=15 February 2023 |website=[[BanglaNews24]] |language=bn}} His parents were Sharfuddin Ansari and Khairunnessa.{{Cite web |url=https://www.daily-sun.com/post/673645/Profile-of-Md-Shahabuddin-Chuppu |title=Profile of Md Shahabuddin Chuppu |date=12 February 2023 |access-date=2023-02-13 |website=[[Daily Sun (Bangladesh)|Daily Sun]] |last=of Bangladesh |first=United |archive-url=https://archive.ph/uzke0 |archive-date=2023-02-13 |url-status=live}} Chuppu went to Pabna's Purbatan Gandhi School until he was admitted to Radhanagar Majumdar Academy at fourth grade. After passing [[Secondary School Certificate|SSC]] examination in 1966, he went to Pabna's [[Govt. Edward College, Pabna|Government Edward College]] and passed [[Higher Secondary School Certificate|HSC]] and [[Bachelor's degree|Bachelor's Degree]] from that college on 1968 and 1972, respectively.{{Cite web |last=Sheikh |first=Emran Hossain |date=12 February 2023 |title=কেন রাষ্ট্রপতি পদে আ.লীগের পছন্দ সাহাবুদ্দিন চুপ্পু? |trans-title=Why Shahabuddin Chuppu is favourite of A.League for the post of President? |url=https://www.banglatribune.com/politics/awami-league/785299/%E0%A6%95%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%A8-%E0%A6%B0%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B7%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%9F%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%B0%E0%A6%AA%E0%A6%A4%E0%A6%BF-%E0%A6%AA%E0%A6%A6%E0%A7%87-%E0%A6%86.%E0%A6%B2%E0%A7%80%E0%A6%97%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%B0-%E0%A6%AA%E0%A6%9B%E0%A6%A8%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%A6-%E0%A6%B8%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B9%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%AC%E0%A7%81%E0%A6%A6%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%A6%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%A8 |access-date=15 February 2023 |website=[[Bangla Tribune]] |language=bn}} Between his HSC and B.Sc. exams, he actively participated in the Bangladeshi liberation movements and the [[Bangladesh Liberation War|liberation war]], while he joined politics even before he passed HSC.{{Citation needed|date=February 2023}} After passing B.Sc., he obtained [[postgraduate degree]] in [[Psychology]] from [[University of Rajshahi]] in 1974, and then [[LLB]] from Martyr Advocate Aminuddin Law College in 1975. == Career == Chuppu was a student leader of the Awami League during the late 1960s and early 1970s. He was the Pabna District convenor of the Shadhin Bangla Chatro Shongram Parishad.{{Cite web |date=2023-02-13 |title=Md Shahabuddin elected 22nd president of Bangladesh |url=https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/md-shahbuddin-elected-22nd-president-bangladesh-584442 |access-date=2023-02-13 |website=The Business Standard |language=en}} He participated in the [[Bangladesh Liberation War|Liberation War]] as a freedom fighter. He was imprisoned after the [[assassination of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman]] in 1975 for three years. In 1982, Chuppu joined as a Munsef (Assistant Judge) of the [[Judiciary of Bangladesh|Judicial Department]] in the [[Bangladesh Civil Service]] (BCS). He was elected to serve as General Secretary of the [[Bangladesh Judicial Service Association|Judicial Service Association]] in 1995 and 1996. Chuppu was appointed by the [[Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs]] to serve as a coordinator in the trial to prosecute the assassins of the [[Father of the Nation]] [[Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman]]. He served as Election Commissioner in the 2022 National Council of Bangladesh Awami League.{{Cite web |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2023/02/12/shahabuddin-chuppu-becomes-president-elect |title=Shahabuddin Chuppu becomes president-elect |date=12 February 2023 |access-date=2023-02-13 |website=[[Dhaka Tribune]] |last=Desk |first=Tribune |archive-url=https://archive.ph/AXL6N |archive-date=2023-02-13 |url-status=live}} In February 2023, Chuppu, resigned from the board of directors of [[Islami Bank Bangladesh Limited]] after being elected President of Bangladesh, a position he held since 2017.{{Cite web |date=2023-02-13 |title=President-elect Shahabuddin resigns from Islami Bank’s board |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/news/president-elect-shahabuddin-resigns-islami-banks-board-3246921 |access-date=2023-04-16 |website=The Daily Star |language=en}} === Presidency === ==== Election ==== {{see also|2023 Bangladeshi presidential election}} Shahabuddin was nominated by the Awami League Parlimentary Party as their candidate for [[President of Bangladesh]].{{Cite web |title=AL nominates Shahabuddin as candidate for Bangladesh president |url=https://www.newagebd.net/article/194238/al-nominates-shahabuddin-as-candidate-for-bangladesh-president |access-date=2023-02-13 |website=New Age {{!}} The Most Popular Outspoken English Daily in Bangladesh |language=en}} On 12 February 2023, he submitted his application to the Chief Election Commissioner and the Presidential Election Officer at the [[Bangladesh Election Commission|Election Commission]] for the [[2023 Bangladeshi presidential election|presidential election]], the only candidate to do so.{{Cite news |last=PTI |date=2023-02-12 |title=Shahabuddin Chuppu set to become next Bangladesh president |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/shahabuddin-chuppu-set-to-become-next-bangladesh-president/article66500475.ece |access-date=2023-02-13 |issn=0971-751X}} Upon filing his nomination, he stated "Everything is Allah's will".{{Cite web |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2023/02/12/md-shahabuddin-everything-is-allahs-will |title=Everything is Allah's will, Shahabuddin Chuppu says |date=12 February 2023 |access-date=2023-02-13 |website=[[Dhaka Tribune]] |last=of Bangladesh |first=United News |archive-url=https://archive.ph/lxhBs |archive-date=2023-02-13 |url-status=live}}{{Cite web |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2023/02/12/who-is-shahabuddin-chuppu-the-next-president-of-bangladesh#:~:text=February%2011%2C%202023%2011%3A12%20PM%20The%20ruling%20Awami,Shahabuddin%20Chuppu%20as%20the%2022nd%20president%20of%20Bangladesh. |title=Who is Shahabuddin Chuppu, the next president of Bangladesh? |date=12 February 2023 |access-date=2023-02-13 |website=[[Dhaka Tribune]] |last=Asif Shawon |first=Ali |archive-url=https://archive.ph/gkj5Q |archive-date=2023-02-13 |url-status=live}} Shahabuddin then held a tête-à-tête with [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh|Prime Minister]] [[Sheikh Hasina]] at [[Ganabhaban]].{{Cite web |url=https://www.daily-sun.com/post/673667/ALnominated-president-candidate-Shahabuddin-calls-on-PM |title=AL-nominated president candidate Shahabuddin calls on PM |date=2023-02-12 |access-date=2023-02-14 |website=[[Daily Sun (Bangladesh)|Daily Sun]] |last=Sangbad Sangstha |first=Bangladesh |archive-url=https://archive.ph/xoRAX |archive-date=2023-02-14 |url-status=live}} His nomination was welcomed by [[GM Quader]] of the opposition [[Jatiya Party (Ershad)|Jatiya Party]] who said "I congratulate him from my heart. I know him for a long time. He is a good person. I hope he would discharge the duty with sincerity for betterment of the country and the nation." while the [[Bangladesh Nationalist Party]] expressed their disinterest.{{Cite web |url=https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/politics/x7uhuocyxl |title=BNP has no interest, JaPa welcomes next president Shahabuddin |date=12 February 2023 |access-date=2023-02-13 |website=[[Prothom Alo]] |author=Staff Correspondent |archive-url=https://archive.ph/iJM6P |archive-date=2023-02-13 |url-status=live}} On 13 February 2023, Shahabuddin was officially elected as the country's 22nd president as he was unopposed. The result was declared by the [[Chief Election Commissioner of Bangladesh|Chief Election Commissioner]] [[Kazi Habibul Awal]].{{cite web |title=সংবাদ বিজ্ঞপ্তি |url=http://www.ecs.gov.bd/files/1010TiaK4Nk5oYCjP9V4zOfr94rAeE0giSQHRhXq.pdf |website=www.ecs.gov.bd |publisher=[[Bangladesh Election Commission]] |access-date=13 February 2023 |language=bn}}{{Cite web |author=Staff Correspondent |title=Mohammad Shahabuddin elected 22nd president of Bangladesh |url=https://en.prothomalo.com/bangladesh/v7du0ml03h |access-date=2023-02-13 |website=Prothomalo |language=en}} His nomination received an especially joyous response in his native Pabna.{{Cite web |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/pabna-joy-after-nomination-shahabuddin-3246251 |title=Pabna in joy after nomination of Shahabuddin |date=2023-02-13 |access-date=2023-02-14 |website=[[The Daily Star (Bangladesh)|The Daily Star]] |last=Pabna |first=Correspondent |archive-url=https://archive.ph/rwzsA |archive-date=2023-02-14 |url-status=live}} == Personal life == Chuppu is married to [[Rebecca Sultana]], a former joint secretary to the [[Government of Bangladesh]]. Together they have a son.{{Cite web |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/politics/2023/02/12/bnp-says-it-is-unconcerned-by-presidential-election |title=BNP says it is unconcerned by presidential election |date=12 February 2023 |access-date=2023-02-13 |website=Dhaka Tribune |last=Farhin Antara |first=Nawaz |archive-url=https://archive.ph/cD4jo |archive-date=2023-02-13 |url-status=live}} ==Legacy== In his honour, a park built by the Pabna Municipality in 2020 was named 'Bir Mukti Joddha Mohammad Sahabuddin Chuppu Amusement Park'.{{cite news |title=পাবনায় 'মুক্তিযোদ্ধা মোহাম্মদ সাহাবুদ্দিন চুপ্পু বিনোদন পার্ক' উদ্বোধন|language=bn |url=https://www.jugantor.com/country-news/321714/পাবনায়-মুক্তিযোদ্ধা-মোহাম্মদ-সাহাবুদ্দিন-চুপ্পু-বিনোদন-পার্ক-উদ্বোধন |newspaper=[[Jugantor]] |access-date=12 February 2023 |date=1 July 2020}} == References == {{Reflist}} {{BangladeshPresidents}} {{Bangladesh Awami League}} {{Heads of state of republics}} {{Current Socialist rulers}} {{Authority control}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Chuppu, Shahabuddin}} [[Category:1949 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:People from Pabna District]] [[Category:Pabna Edward College alumni]] [[Category:University of Rajshahi alumni]] [[Category:Bengali Muslims]] [[Category:20th-century Bengalis]] [[Category:21st-century Bengalis]] [[Category:People of the Bangladesh Liberation War]] [[Category:Awami League politicians]] [[Category:Presidents of Bangladesh]]
